title: RIDE: Enhancing Large Language Model Alignment through Restyled In-Context Learning Demonstration Exemplars
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'alignment tuning' to ensure LLMs behave 'ethically and helpfully.' It specifically explores and evaluates the 'safety' dimension of alignment, which involves testing the model's ability to refuse malicious or inappropriate queries (e.g., cyberbullying) and provide helpful, value-aligned responses using benchmarks like just-eval-instruct and SORRY-Bench.
